scope: Conditional circuit oracle, not identified vintage semiconductor models

bjt_provenance.law: NG-46 PDF pp. 138-145; Gummel-Poon subset with explicit charge
bjt_provenance.parameters: Laboratory hypotheses; shared NPN/PNP values, not a fit to CA3046/2N3392/2N4058/2N4402/2N3906
bjt_provenance.q5_q6_part_conflict: Unresolved; common conditional PNP card does not distinguish manufacturers or candidate part numbers

jfet_provenance.derivation: BETA=IDSS/(VTO^2*(1+LAMBDA*20)); CGD=Crss*sqrt(1+20/PB); CGS=Ciss-Crss. Not a manufacturer SPICE fit.
jfet_provenance.uncertainty: VTO -2.5 V, LAMBDA .003/V, PB 1 V, IS and junction laws are hypotheses. Ciss/Crss are typical source values; actual operating bias differs. Equal halves assume zero mismatch.

opamp.uncertainty: Official National/TI macromodel, not identified 741 population in a vintage Minimoog. Original file stays private.
